newsitem.title: USA: Olympic Fin'l begins $300 mln debt offer.
newsitem.headline: Olympic Fin'l begins $300 mln debt offer.

text.p: Olympic Financial Ltd said Friday it began a public offering of $300 million senior notes due 2007 under a current shelf registration effective with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
It expects to complete the offering in early March.

Net proceeds will be used to finance the purchase of outstanding 13 percent senior notes, due 2000, tendered under its offer to purchase and consent solicitation. Proceeds also will go towards purchase of automobile loans and for working capital.
Olympic Financial is a consumer finance company.
